{{Quote|Among the Caamasi, a bodyservant does not shoot his master.|Elegos A'Kla to "Jenos Idanian"|<ref name="I, Jedi">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref>}}
'''Bodyservant''' was the term given to a person whose occupation it was to serve as the personal assistant to a given being, acting on behalf of and in assistance to their master in many ways. A bodyservant was often, but not always, [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] to the person whom they served. In [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], [[Elegos A'Kla]] voluntarily took up the post of bodyservant to [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]], then masquerading as [[Jenos Idanian]], in order to maintain the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] cover among the [[Khuiumin Survivors]] and the [[Invids]] that he had infiltrated.
